description.zh: 使用现有研究工具分析来源观测，保存方法版本和参考复现回执。
description.en: Analyze source observations using existing research tools; retain method version and reference receipt.

scope.zh: 相同属性、原单位和测试条件的选定观测；最多 300 条。
scope.en: Selected matching-property, original-unit, same-condition observations; up to 300 rows.

limitations.zh: 结论需要科研人员复核。参考复现不代表材料领域验证。
limitations.en: Scientific interpretation requires review. Reference reproduction is not material-domain validation.

sources.citation: MaterialsX experiments/math.mjs; independent implementation, not NIST software

licenses.basis: Reference links only; no paper text copied
NIST employee datasets; attribution and AS IS notice preserved in methods/references/NOTICE.txt; numerical benchmark only
Fixed CPU float64 algorithm; no trained model

scope.zh: PiDigits 5000 个构造数值的均值与样本标准差；仅检验数值算法。
scope.en: Mean and sample SD of 5000 constructed PiDigits values; numerical algorithm only.

instructions.zh: 先搜索方法包，再读取选定数据和证据，运行 research_methods 筛选及 research_method_run。不得直接执行候选包代码或把复现通过当作领域验证。
instructions.en: Search packages, read selected observations and evidence, assess with research_methods, then run research_method_run. Never execute candidate code or treat reference reproduction as domain validation.

examples.zh: @materials-method-packages 汇总已选来源的均值；未确认独立制样时不要计算标准误，输出 JSON 和报告。
examples.en: @materials-method-packages Summarize selected values; no standard error without confirmed independent specimens. Write JSON and a report.

description.zh: 使用现有研究工具分析来源观测，保存方法版本和参考复现回执。
description.en: Analyze source observations using existing research tools; retain method version and reference receipt.

scope.zh: 3–300 对有证据的观测，X 非常量；保持原单位、材料基准和测试条件。
scope.en: 3–300 evidence-linked pairs with nonconstant X; preserve original units, material basis and conditions.

limitations.zh: 结论需要科研人员复核。参考复现不代表材料领域验证。
limitations.en: Scientific interpretation requires review. Reference reproduction is not material-domain validation.

licenses.basis: Reference links only; no paper text copied
NIST employee datasets; attribution and AS IS notice preserved in methods/references/NOTICE.txt; numerical benchmark only
Fixed CPU float64 algorithm; no trained model

scope.zh: NIST Norris 的 36 对臭氧仪校准值及四项认证回归统计量；不证明材料模型有效。
scope.en: 36 NIST Norris ozone-monitor calibration pairs and four certified regression statistics; not material-model validity.

instructions.zh: 先搜索方法包，再读取选定数据和证据，运行 research_methods 筛选及 research_method_run。不得直接执行候选包代码或把复现通过当作领域验证。
instructions.en: Search packages, read selected observations and evidence, assess with research_methods, then run research_method_run. Never execute candidate code or treat reference reproduction as domain validation.

examples.zh: @materials-method-packages 对已选成对观测进行线性拟合，报告斜率、残差和输入范围，不作范围外预测。
examples.en: @materials-method-packages Fit selected paired observations; report slope, residuals and training domain without extrapolation.
